service.ur: ڈینٹل امپلانٹ کی مشق کی اجازت

about: Ask the Department of Health for permission for a dentist to practise dental implantology.
note: Requirements read from the official Department of Health Abu Dhabi FAQ page on the checked date. The request is sent by email, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Specialist dentists need a postgraduate specialty programme with implant teaching and clinical training, or an accredited postgraduate clinical programme in implantology
General dentists need an accredited postgraduate clinical programme in implantology
The facility's own privileging committee must still grant internal privileges
channels: Apply to the Health Workforce Licensing and Medical Education division at hplicensing@doh.gov.ae
